chunks: But never once an apostle came to them at whom they did not scoff.
ai.seo_question: Why did the Israelites mock every prophet sent to them?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Al-An'am (6:47) underscores the 'sunnah of Allah' regarding the rejection of prophets, linking the Israelites' mockery to their spiritual arrogance and eventual exile. It serves as a precursor to the finality of Prophethood, emphasizing that while previous communities dismissed their messengers, the Ummah of Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family) is called to heed the final revelation without the same pattern of derision.
